kol_archive.detail: Coding tokens are basically infrastructure. Yet, the way companies have approached them amounts to: "Hey all, here's an AWS key. It can spin up anything from a 𝚝𝟹.𝚗𝚊𝚗𝚘 (＄𝟹.𝟾𝟶/𝚖𝚘) to an 𝚙𝟻.𝟺𝟾𝚡𝚕𝚊𝚛𝚐𝚎 (＄𝟺𝟶𝚔/𝚖𝚘). Go wild" And obviously the reason companies don't do this for their core infra is that you need to govern, optimize, and observe usage and costs. The intern might decide to host a static website in that 192 vCPU machine, and you won't be very happy about the bill. AI Gateway fixes this for all your tokens, with per-key, and now per-user budgets.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出，编程 Token 实为基础设施，但企业管理却如发放无限制 AWS 密钥，允许从低成本到月费 4 万美元实例随意调用，严重缺乏治理与成本观测。他强调 AI Gateway 解决此痛点，新增按密钥及按用户预算控制，防止资源滥用如用昂贵实例托管静态网站。

It’s like a 9.8 earthquake on the seismic scale. It affects default configs, requires no auth, no user interaction. It’s an RCE bomb because Artifactory hosts binaries, so you can basically poison everything, but an admin escalation can cause damage even beyond that. When the OpenAI / Hugging Face news came out of agents discovering zero-days, I was wondering if it was marketing-speak or reality, because I hadn’t seen a CVE filing. Now it’s here: I don’...
kol_archive.detail_zh: JFrog 近日披露 CVE‑2026‑82329，这是 Artifactory 默认配置存在的严重身份绕过漏洞，CVSS 得分 9.8，无需身份验证且无用户交互即可触发远程代码执行，可用于投毒二进制甚至提升管理员权限造成更大破坏。此前 OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 报告称 AI 代理能发现零日漏洞曾被质疑为营销言论，而现在该 CVE 的出现证明了其真实性。

kol_archive.detail: AI Gateway can now call webhooks after long generations 😍 ① Lower compute costs (no long-running process waiting idly) ② More reliable. Gateway can take more of the processing burden ③ You can 𝚊𝚠𝚊𝚒𝚝 𝚑𝚘𝚘𝚔() in "𝚞𝚜𝚎 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚠" to sanely consume these
kol_archive.detail_zh: AI Gateway 新增在长时间生成结束后触发 webhook 的功能，既能避免长时间闲置的计算开销，又提升了可靠性，使网关能够承担更多处理负荷。用户可在 “use workflow” 中通过 await hook() 合理消费这些回调，从而实现资源利用的更高效。

kol_archive.take: agent 越能自主改代码，底层 runtime 越需要确定性、隔离与恢复能力；更快的生成速度反而提高了工程约束的重要性。
kol_archive.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol_archive.take_zh: Run SDK 推出安全 eval 功能，可在轻量 QuickJS 环境中直接执行智能体生成的代码，既无需完整沙箱，也带来更快的运行速度和更低的成本。
kol_archive.detail: We're introducing Run SDK: secure 𝚎𝚟𝚊𝚕 for dynamic Code Mode execution. When agents write code, you don't always need a full sandbox. You can 𝚛𝚞𝚗 their code in a lightweight QuickJS secure context. Faster and more cost-efficient. 𝚗𝚙𝚖 𝚒 𝚛𝚞𝚗
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 在 X 上宣布推出 Run SDK，为动态 Code Mode 执行提供安全的 eval 功能。该方案采用轻量级 QuickJS 安全上下文运行代理生成的代码，无需完整沙箱，因而更快且成本更低。开发者可通过 npm 安装指令 `npm i run` 直接使用。

kol_archive.detail: Daisy Wolf and Eva Steinman are joined by Engy Ziedan, co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Protege, to discuss why medical AI has a measurement problem, and why scoring well on a benchmark doesn't necessarily mean a model is ready for the hospital. Engy explains why healthcare AI needs independent evaluations that go beyond static exams and measure how models actually perform in real-world clinical workflows. They explore the risks of subtle bias and misalignment, why the same model can rank differently depending on how it's prompted or tested, and what happens as AI becomes more person...

kol_archive.detail: tbh this is a good debate to have. Here is what the timeline of the near past/future looks like to me: 1. Models are able to code better than I can 2. Models are able to do coding-adjacent engineering work better than I can: debugging, profiling, optimizing, bug fixing, system design, abstraction design, ui design, idea generation, etc. 3. Models are able to do most things that can be done on a computer better than most people For the kinds of coding that I do, Claude has achieved 1 and some (but not all) of 2. It is showing early-ish signs of 3. This is not the case for all coding yet. If you...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Boris Cherny 认为，AI 已在代码编写上超越他个人水平，并在调试、性能分析、优化、错误修复、系统与抽象设计、UI 设计和创意生成等编码相关工程任务上也表现更好。他指出，Claude 已实现第一阶段的能力，并在部分第二阶段任务上有所进展，显示出向全面计算机任务超越大多数人（第三阶段）迈进的早期迹象，但尚未在所有编码场景中达到此水平。

kol_archive.take_en: Model monetization is better tracked through real routing and $ spend share than benchmarks; channel share reveals who is monetizing production traffic.
kol_archive.take_zh: Vercel AI Gateway 数据显示，8 月 22 日开放权重模型代币消耗占比达 62%，较两个月前的 28.4% 大幅跃升，封闭权重模型份额降至 38%。
kol_archive.detail: Today's a record day for open weight share of tokens on Vercel AI Gateway. Aug 22 (today) 🟦 Open: 62% 🟨 Closed: 38% Jun 24 (~2 months ago) 🟦 Open: 28.4% 🟨 Closed: 71.6% This is very likely just the start, because enterprise adoption is still early, and harnesses, CLIs, IDEs, SDKs, etc need to be adapted to be model agnostic.
kol_archive.detail_zh: 吉列尔莫·劳赫在 X 上指出，8 月 22 日（今日）Vercel AI Gateway 的开放权重代币份额达到历史最高的 62%，封闭权重为 38%；而 6 月 24 日大约两个月前的数据为开放 28.4%，封闭 71.6%。他认为这只是开始，因为企业采用仍处于早期阶段，各类工具链（harnesses、CLI、IDE、SDK）还需进一步适配以实现模型无关。
